purpose: Redesign both hero costumes to normal crewmate proportions

prompts.super:
Create a transparent production sprite atlas for the SuperHero costume in an Among Us mod, redesigned to match an ordinary crewmate's EXACT compact body proportions. Reference 1 is the mandatory body shape and scale guide; reference 2 gives the existing costume's colors/identity only; reference 3 is the ladder-up pose guide and reference 4 is the ladder-down pose guide.

CRITICAL REDESIGN: use the normal rounded one-piece bean-shaped crewmate head/torso, same large oval cyan visor, short stubby feet and rounded small backpack as reference 1. No tall boots, long legs, shoulder armor, large helmet, human superhero physique, muscles, or enlarged torso. The costume must fit ON the usual crewmate rather than replacing it with a taller/wider superhero. Blue suit with a small gold diamond chest emblem, thin gold belt, simple gold toe details and red cape. Keep cape behind the body, modest width/length, clear flat cel shading, thick smooth dark outline, same clean game style as reference 1. No aura, particles, cast shadow or background.

ONE EXACT GRID of FOUR COLUMNS and SIX ROWS, all 24 cells equal-sized square cells with generous transparent margins. No grid lines or labels. Native crewmate body has identical height/width/scale throughout; torso shape/visor rigid. Each individual full figure entirely within its cell. Face RIGHT in idle/walk.
ROW 1: idle, walk frame 1, walk frame 2, walk frame 3.
ROW 2: walk frames 4,5,6,7.
ROW 3: walk frames 8,9,10,11.
ROW 4: walk frame 12, ladder ascent A (back view, left mitten above head and right mitten lower), ladder ascent B (back view, right mitten above head and left mitten lower), ladder descent (back view, BOTH mittens above head).
ROW 5: crouched vent-entry pose; zipline seated 1; zipline seated 2; zipline seated 3.
ROW 6: zipline seated 4; remaining three cells completely EMPTY transparent.

The 12 walk poses must alternate short feet over one smooth complete stride with the RED cape fluttering visibly through 12 different waves. Body stays at a constant design scale and near-constant head position; no stretching/squashing. Ladder back views show NO face visor or chest emblem, show a rounded small backpack and cape; mittens float separated from the body, no connecting human arms.
All FOUR zipline poses follow original Fungle posture: body reclines backward to LEFT ~25 degrees, both stubby knees tuck UP and both feet project FORWARD to RIGHT in a seated pose. Exactly one SMALL floating mitten detached well above/right of the body, SAME grip location in all four zipline cells. NO connecting arm or long stalk. Red cape flutters behind/left in four waves.
Make all art genuinely transparent RGBA. No text, watermark, reference-guide palette colors or extra characters. This is final game asset artwork, not a presentation board.
prompts.superCorrections:
Edit this SuperHero production sprite atlas, preserving EXACTLY the 4-column by 6-row grid, all pose positions, compact normal-crewmate body proportions, blue/gold suit, red cape, all 12 walking frames, and all four seated zipline frames. Two corrections ONLY:
1. Completely remove every colored glow, halo, aura and shadow around every sprite. Every pixel outside the clean dark outline must have ALPHA ZERO. Truly clean cutout RGBA, no blue haze, red haze, dark gradient, floor, checkerboard or background.
2. In the three ladder back-view cells (ROW 4 columns 2, 3 and 4), remove the reference guide's pure RED/BLUE body-mask patches. These are the same BLUE superhero suit and blue rounded backpack as the idle character, with dark-blue shadows and RED cape. Exposed top/back of helmet BLUE, not RED. The floating mittens must be small GOLD superhero gloves with dark-blue outlines, NOT the reference's red/blue striped hands. Back view has no chest diamond and no front visor.
Keep row 6 columns 2-4 completely empty transparent. All other shapes/positions/identity and frame count unchanged. Do not add text or extra artwork.
prompts.superGloves: Make one small correction to this transparent SuperHero sprite atlas. Change ONLY the four RED floating mitten hands belonging to the seated ZIPLINE poses into GOLD/YELLOW gloves, matching the gold gloves already used by this character in the ladder poses. The four hands to recolor are in ROW 5 columns 2, 3 and 4, and ROW 6 column 1. Preserve their existing exact silhouette, size, outline and pixel anchor; recolor the red fill to gold/yellow with orange shadow. Do NOT recolor the red cape. Preserve all other pixels/artwork, all 24 cell locations in the 4-column/6-row atlas, the normal-crewmate body proportions, all walking poses, all ladder poses and blue/gold costume identity. Preserve the current transparent alpha cutout and leave all pixels outside sprite outlines alpha zero. No added glow, background, shadow, text, grid or watermark.
prompts.superProportions: Correct body proportions of this existing SuperHero sprite atlas while preserving its EXACT 4-column/6-row layout, colors, cell contents and all pose anchors. Make the torso/helmet/backpack silhouette about 14 percent NARROWER relative to its current height, so it matches an ORIGINAL Among Us crewmate rather than a wide chibi hero. Use the second reference's torso/visor/backpack proportions as the strict shape guide. Preserve the current body height and short stubby legs. The small backpack should hug the torso closely; do not let it balloon outward. Do not enlarge the visor. Keep a normal single bean-shaped head and torso, without a separate helmet or human chest. Redesign the contours naturally; do not make it look horizontally squashed. Apply the same slimmer native shape to ALL idle/walking/ladder/vent/zipline cells. Keep cape, small diamond/belt and gloves consistent with blue suit/red cape/gold details. Preserve 12 walking poses, two ladder-up poses, one ladder-down, vent, and four seated zipline poses with one detached gold mitten above/right. Keep all four zipline grip positions unchanged and last three cells empty. Genuine RGBA transparency, alpha zero outside sprite contours, no colored aura/halo/shadow/background, no labels or extra characters.
prompts.evil:
Create the EVIL HERO version of the first reference atlas. Reference 1 is the EDIT TARGET and mandatory exact pose/grid/scale guide. Reference 2 is the normal crewmate silhouette/proportion guide. Reference 3 shows the OLD evil costume solely as a color/identity reference.

Keep the first atlas's EXACT FOUR columns, SIX rows, same compact native Among Us crewmate body shape and the same pose in every cell. Change the costume throughout all 21 populated cells to EVIL HERO: charcoal-black/dark violet bean-shaped suit and rounded helmet/body, violet shadows, pale LILAC visor with simple white shine, small angular MAGENTA/VIOLET diamond chest emblem, thin MAGENTA belt, purple toe details and PURPLE cape. Replace ALL gold gloves with VIOLET gloves, including the floating hands in ladder AND zipline poses. Replace ALL blue suit/backpack areas with charcoal/dark violet, ALL red cape areas with purple. No red/blue reference-mask patches. No gold left. No red hands.
The body remains the ordinary crewmate's compact rounded bean silhouette: NO extended helmet fins or horns, NO large shoulder plates, NO long human legs, NO muscles, NO extra height or bulky armor. Very subtle angular face-panel markings are fine INSIDE the existing outline. Same native-sized cyan-visor geometry, but recolored LILAC. Retain clean thick dark outlines and flat game cel shading.

Pose mapping must remain:
ROW 1: idle, walk 1, walk 2, walk 3.
ROW 2: walk 4,5,6,7.
ROW 3: walk 8,9,10,11.
ROW 4: walk 12; ladder up A left glove high; ladder up B right glove high; ladder down both gloves high.
ROW 5: vent crouch; seated zipline 1; seated zipline 2; seated zipline 3.
ROW 6: seated zipline 4; THREE COMPLETELY EMPTY transparent cells.
Walk cape flutters through 12 wave shapes with identical torso scale. Ladder back views show no front visor and no chest emblem. Zipline is seated/reclining, both knees tucked upward and feet toward RIGHT, ONE small DETACHED PURPLE mitten above/right, same grip anchor across all four cells, no connecting arm.
TRUE transparent background. Do not generate colored glows, haze, gradient, cast shadow, aura, floor, labels, grid lines or watermark. Every pixel outside the dark sprite outlines should be alpha zero.
prompts.evilProportions: Correct body proportions of the EVIL HERO atlas in reference 1 to match the newly corrected normal-sized SuperHero atlas in reference 2. Reference 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Reference 2 is ONLY the mandatory body-proportion/size guide; do not copy its colors. Preserve the exact 4-column by 6-row layout and poses of reference 1. Make the torso, helmet and small backpack about 14 percent narrower at the same body height to fit the original Among Us crewmate bean shape, naturally redrawing contours rather than squashing them. Match reference 2's compact rounded normal-crewmate torso, small backpack and short stubby feet. No extra large helmet, fins, shoulder armor or human legs. Keep charcoal-black/violet suit, LILAC visor, small magenta-violet chest diamond and thin magenta belt, purple toe details, PURPLE cape and PURPLE gloves. NO gold, blue or red. Same 12 different walk poses/cape waves, two back-view ladder up poses with alternating high/low floating mittens, one ladder-down with both mittens above head, vent crouch and four reclining seated zipline poses. Each zipline has exactly one detached small purple mitten above/right, same grip anchor and forward tucked knees. All pose anchors and 24 equal cell locations unchanged. Keep last three cells completely empty. True transparent RGBA alpha zero outside sprite outlines; no aura, halo, shadow, background, text, grid or watermark.
